'); const P = document.getElementById('rpaPlay'), $p = id => document.getElementById(id); for (let i = 1; i <= 40; i++) $p('pList').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', ''); $p('pCount').onclick = () => __p.n++; $p('pCount').ondblclick = () => __p.dbl = true; $p('pCount').oncontextmenu = e => { e.preventDefault(); __p.right = true; }; $p('pHide').onclick = () => setTimeout(() => $p('pHide').remove(), 500); $p('pName').oninput = e => __p.name = e.target.value; $p('pName').onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') __p.enter = true; if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'a') __p.all = true; }; $p('pCol').onchange = e => __p.col = e.target.value; $p('pAgree').onchange = e => __p.agree = e.target.checked; $p('pHover').onmouseenter = () => __p.hover = true; $p('pHover').onmouseover = () => __p.hover = true; P.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target.classList.contains('pRow')) __p.row = e.target.textContent; }); $p('pSrc').onmousedown = () => __p.dragging = true; document.addEventListener('mouseup', e => { if (!__p.dragging) return; __p.dragging = false; const r = $p('pDst').getBoundingClientRect(); if (e.clientX >= r.left && e.clientX <= r.right && e.clientY >= r.top && e.clientY <= r.bottom) { __p.dropped = true; $p('pOut').textContent = 'Dropped'; } }, true); return true
